Chapter 6896: Rebuild

Chapter 6896: Rebuild

“Hard to say.” Guangmai smiled at Big-foot Immortal: “Big-foot can elaborate since this heart has been around since Golden Immortal’s generation.”

“Hmm...” Big-foot was caught off guard.

“I know you have an answer since your race has deep roots in this world before any of us.” Guangmai said.

“You were the first one here after it appeared.” Extinguish said.

Amusingly enough, although most cultivators here had a prejudice against Immortal Emperor Gu Chun for being an outsider, so were they.

Only a few were truly natives of Stygian, Big-foot being the oldest. He had lived here all his life and received guidance from Golden Immortal.

“It’s embarrassing but I must admit I was too young to know about this world’s heart. Understanding of this phenomenon came from Golden Immortal. Perhaps the master of Origination Enterprise might have an answer as well.” Big-foot said.

He naturally knew a bit more but it would be unwise in this situation to reveal everything.

“Can’t ask Origination right now.” Guangmai shook his head.

“Your Highness, you were the first to chase the Gate of Wisdom, I’m sure you know more than the rest of us, given your intelligence.” Big-foot said.

“Hahaha, so it’s on me now.” Guangmai said.

“That is not what i mean, Your Highness.” Big-foot broke out in cold sweat and prostrated.

Of course, the crowd agreed with Big-foot. Guangmai certainly knew more than anyone here.

“Yes, I have been chasing the Gate of Wisdom. It belonged to Golden Immortal and then me, but it went missing after a chance meeting with Genesis.” He said calmly.

He had always wanted the world’s heart to surpass his master. However, this was easier said than done. His master was ancient on top of being a shored immortal.

This goal was the reason why he never cared about leading the alliance, allowing Zhao Dachiu to take over.

He was rewarded and found the gate. Something rather interesting happened in this moment - he met the greatest genius he had ever seen. This person came from the nine worlds and a battle ensued.

The monster somehow surpassed two major realms to become competitive. Unfortunately, he was facing an ancient immortal.

Guangmai crushed him and pursued at all cost. Letting this genius live meant the end of him in the future. Alas, he failed to put an end to this young cultivator.

When he returned to the gate, Genesis from Heaven Assault was there. He lost the fight and the gate went missing.

Due to his injuries, he became inactive for a long period. This turned out to be a blessing, preventing him from participating in the war against Immortal Emperor Min Ren and Heaven Pit. Otherwise, the probability of death would have been high.

Once he had healed completely, he found that the gate had been opened. This saved a lot of effort.

Now, he has also gained “authority”. If he could obtain the heart, he would be able to become a celestial immortal. Surpassing his master would no longer be a dream.

“Open the gate to see the heart.” Big-foot said softly.

“Yes, and the heart is right before us. However, it is not meant to be devoured.” Guangmai said.

“Then what is it used for?” Controller asked.

Although everyone here was tempted to eat it, they wouldn’t dare to go against Guangmai.

“We can rebuild a world.” Guangmai said.

“What kind of world?” Fire Immortal asked.

“That depends on what we need, perhaps a world no different from others but capable of granting us dark power and birthing dark existences.” Guangmai said.

“Creation, that’s the high heaven’s business.” The three messengers exchanged glances.

“Close enough.” Guangmai smiled.

“A world of darkness filled with life, so many to be devoured then.” Immortal Devourer salivated.

“A farm for all of us, so that we can escape the fundamentals of the dao heart to reach higher realms.” Guangmai said.

The crowd became excited and rowdy due to the possibilities of such a world.
